definitions.explanation: The way something is used, or instructions on how to use something. Applied to both medicine/products (dosage and directions) and language (grammatical usage).

examples.japanese: {用法|ようほう}・⟦{用量|ようりょう}→用量：18412_youryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: To follow the dosage and directions for use.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{用法|ようほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please teach me the correct usage of this word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{用法|ようほう}・⟦{用量|ようりょう}→用量：18412_youryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please always follow the doctor's instructions regarding the usage and dosage of the medicine.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in two contexts: (1) medical/product instructions, almost always in the fixed phrase {用法|ようほう}・⟦{用量|ようりょう}→用量：18412_youryou⟧ (dosage and directions), and (2) linguistics/grammar, referring to how a word or expression is used. The medical usage is extremely common on medicine packaging and in pharmacy instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {用法|ようほう}・⟦{用量|ようりょう}→用量：18412_youryou⟧: dosage and directions (fixed pair on medicine labels)
- {用法|ようほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to follow the directions for use
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{用法|ようほう}: correct usage
- {用法|ようほう}⟦{用量|ようりょう}→用量：18412_youryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to follow dosage and directions
